scripts.web:build: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && (cp styles.css www/ || cp src/styles.css www/ || true) && cp src/fetch-data.js www/ && (cp -r components www/ || cp -r src/components www/ || cp -r Components www/ || cp -r src/Components www/) && (cp -r tabs www/ || cp -r src/tabs www/ || cp -r Tabs www/ || cp -r src/Tabs www/) && sed 's|\.\./||g' src/index.html > www/index.html
scripts.cap:sync: npm run web:build && npx cap sync android
